guardrails: It is unacceptable to remove or edit existing tests
Do not mark features as 'passing' until build succeeds
Always use design tokens, never hardcoded values
Commit changes after completing each feature
Update progress.txt before exiting each iteration
Work on ONE feature at a time
notes: Features should be atomic - completable in one iteration
Priority 1 = highest, work on lowest number first
Build must succeed before marking feature complete
Use SwiftUI previews for visual verification
